title: Virus Concentration from Wastewater Using PEG Precipitation and Ultracentrifugation
author: Jacquelina.Woods
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bx9ipr4e

steps.title: Prepare Wastewater Sample
steps.instruction: Place 800 mL of wastewater into an 1L centrifuge bottle.

steps.title: Add Controls and Reagents
steps.instruction: Add the extraction control, PEG, and HCl to the wastewater sample.

substeps.instruction: Add 200 µL of extraction control (concentration of 10^2 per mL).

steps.title: Incubate and Centrifuge
steps.instruction: Mix the sample and perform the first centrifugation step.

substeps.instruction: Shake briefly and place bottles in a refrigerated shaker at 100 rpm, 6-8 °C, for 2 hours.
Centrifuge at 8000 x g, 2-6 °C, for 30 minutes (for ThermoFisher RC6, set acceleration at 7 and deceleration at 3, or equivalent speeds for other models).

steps.title: Remove Supernatant
steps.instruction: Carefully pipette and discard the supernatant, ensuring the pellet is not disrupted. Up to 15 mL of residual supernatant may remain.

steps.title: Resuspend and Incubate Pellet
steps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet and incubate on ice.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend pellet in 15 mL of 0.05M glycine and transfer the entire volume to a 50 mL conical tube.
Incubate on ice for 40 minutes (+/- 10 min), vortexing occasionally.

steps.title: Neutralize and Centrifuge
steps.instruction: Neutralize the sample and perform a second centrifugation.

substeps.instruction: Add 15 mL of 2X tc PBS to neutralize and shake by hand to mix.
Centrifuge at 3000 x g, 2-6 °C, for 15 minutes.

steps.title: Prepare for Ultracentrifugation
steps.instruction: Transfer the supernatant and adjust the volume and balance for ultracentrifugation.

substeps.instruction: Transfer supernatant to a clean ultracentrifuge tube, taking care not to disturb the pellet.
Bring total volume up to 65 mL or 125 g total weight (including bottle and cap) by adding 1X tc PBS.
Balance tubes to within 0.05 g of each other using 1X tc PBS.

steps.title: Perform Ultracentrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the sample at high speed (minimum volume for Fiberlite rotor and tubes is 50 mL).

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge at 170000 x g, 2-6 °C, for 45 minutes.

steps.title: Final Resuspension and Aliquoting
steps.instruction: Recover the final concentrate and distribute into tubes.

substeps.instruction: Discard supernatant and resuspend pellet in 800 µL of 1X tc PBS.
Evenly distribute the sample into four 2.0 mL microcentrifuge tubes.

steps.title: Store or Process Concentrates
steps.instruction: Store the concentrates or proceed to RNA extraction.

substeps.instruction: Store concentrates at -70 °C, or use one tube for RNA extraction and store the remaining tubes at -70 °C as reserve.
